Cardiovascular Disease

Ailment cardiovascular heart-disease circulation vascular

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Group of diseases affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and stroke.

Symptoms

  • chest pain
  • shortness of breath
  • fatigue
  • palpitations
  • dizziness
  • swelling in legs/ankles
